description: This is a test source file for the SecurePrefs class, using Robolectric framework to run Android unit tests for preference persistence and migration.

classes.name: SecurePrefsTest
classes.description: A test class for SecurePrefs, verifying location mode migration and gateway token persistence.

methods.name: loadLocationMode_migratesLegacyAlwaysValue
methods.description: Tests that the legacy preference value 'location.enabledMode' with value 'always' migrates to LocationMode.WhileUsing.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken_persistsSeparatelyFromSharedToken
methods.description: Verifies that gateway bootstrap tokens are saved and retrieved correctly, separately from shared tokens.
